import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep (scatter plot)
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
scatter = ax1.scatter(df['Sleep Duration'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 
                     c=df['Stress Level'], cmap='YlOrRd', s=100, alpha=0.6, edgecolors='black')
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax1, label='Stress Level')

# 2. Age distribution
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
ax2.hist(df['Age'], bins=15, color=colors[0], edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax2.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 3. BMI Category distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
bmi_counts = df['BMI Category'].value_counts()
ax3.bar(bmi_counts.index, bmi_counts.values, color=colors[1:4], edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax3.set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_title('BMI Category Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 4. Physical Activity Level by Occupation
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
occupation_activity = df.groupby('Occupation')['Physical Activity Level'].mean().sort_values()
ax4.barh(occupation_activity.index, occupation_activity.values, color=colors[2], edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax4.set_xlabel('Avg Physical Activity Level', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Occupation', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_title('Physical Activity by Occupation', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 5. Stress Level vs Heart Rate
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
ax5.scatter(df['Stress Level'], df['Heart Rate'], s=100, alpha=0.6, 
           c=df['Age'], cmap='viridis', edgecolors='black')
ax5.set_xlabel('Stress Level', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_ylabel('Heart Rate', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_title('Stress Level vs Heart Rate', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 6. Sleep Disorder distribution
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
sleep_disorder = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None').value_counts()
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax6.pie(sleep_disorder.values, labels=sleep_disorder.index, 
                                     autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors[4:], startangle=90)
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')
ax6.set_title('Sleep Disorder Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 7. Daily Steps by BMI Category
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
df.boxplot(column='Daily Steps', by='BMI Category', ax=ax7, patch_artist=True)
ax7.set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_ylabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_title('Daily Steps by BMI Category', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
plt.suptitle('')  # Remove the automatic title

# 8. Quality of Sleep by Gender
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
gender_quality = df.groupby('Gender')['Quality of Sleep'].mean()
ax8.bar(gender_quality.index, gender_quality.values, color=colors[5:7], edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax8.set_xlabel('Gender', fontsize=10)
ax8.set_ylabel('Avg Quality of Sleep', fontsize=10)
ax8.set_title('Quality of Sleep by Gender', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 9. Correlation heatmap for numeric variables
ax9 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
numeric_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = df[numeric_cols].corr()
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', center=0,
            square=True, ax=ax9, cbar_kws={'shrink': 0.8}, annot_kws={'size': 8})
ax9.set_title('Correlation Matrix', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# Main title
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Analysis Dashboard', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
